newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish anti-Islamist MP resigns from Ciller party.
newsitem.headline: Turkish anti-Islamist MP resigns from Ciller party.

text.p: An anti-Islamist MP said on Thursday she had quit Tansu Ciller's True Path Party, in a resignation that boosts secularist Mesut Yilmaz's effort to set up a coalition.
Deputy Isilay Saygin announced she had stepped down in a written statement distributed in parliament.
"Everyone must play a role in protecting the secular, democratic state at this time," she said in the statement.
She was the third person to abandon Ciller since rival Yilmaz was made prime minister-designate last Friday.
Main opposition leader Yilmaz is relying on defections from Ciller's faction to win a vote of confidence in any government he sets up.
He is trying to establish a coalition that would freeze out the Islamists of Necmettin Erbakan, who resigned as prime minister last week after months of army pressure.
